top_signal.title: For those who've hired freelance web devs: why choose a junior over AI/no-code?
top_signal.summary: I'm an early-career freelance web dev. I can code well-defined tasks but I'm still building the judgment side (product decisions, tradeoffs). With AI tools and no-code builders, I'm trying to understand what makes a junior worth hiring.   If you've actually hired freelancers, I'd love to hear:      What problem were you solving when you hired someone instead of using Webflow/AI/templates?     Would you hire someone junior, and what would you trust them with?     What would make you reject an entry-level freelancer immediately?      Concrete stories are the most helpful. Thanks!       submitted by     /u/AdIllustrious8354       [link]       [comments]
